map.评估产线产能利用率,规划设备/工时/班次: Evaluates line capacity utilization and plans equipment, working hours and shifts
map.📖 查看「产能规划计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to capacity planning calculation
map.理论产能 = 设备数 × 单台班产能 × 班次数 × 工作天数；产能利用率 =: Theoretical capacity = machines × capacity per machine-shift × shifts × working days; utilization = demand ÷ theoretical capacity × 100% (uncapped, values above 100% are shown as-is); capacity gap = demand − theoretical capacity (positive means a shortfall, requiring more machines or extra shifts); required machines = demand ÷ (capacity per machine-shift × shifts × days), rounded up; a load rate above 90% means tight capacity and below 60% means surplus, so shifts or the schedule can be adjusted. This page has no equipment-efficiency input, so the formula has no efficiency term; the four modes output utilization, machine demand, machine-day demand, and the single-process bottleneck gap.
map.新生产线投资或排产会前，先用本工具测算满足月度订单所需的最少设备台数与班次，避免: Before investing in a new production line or holding a scheduling meeting, use this tool to work out the minimum number of machines and shifts needed to meet monthly orders, avoiding blind expansion or leaving a capacity gap.
map.淡旺季切换时，调整班次（1/2/3 班）评估产能利用率，判断是否需要增加班次或将: When switching between low and high seasons, adjust the number of shifts (1 / 2 / 3) to evaluate capacity utilization and decide whether to add shifts or divert spare capacity to other orders.
map.接到突发大单时，快速核算当前设备配置能否在交期内达成，并定位需要优先扩容的瓶颈工: When an unexpected large order arrives, quickly check whether the current equipment configuration can deliver within the deadline, and locate the bottleneck process that should be expanded first.
map.某机加工车间 5 台 CNC、单台班产能 200 件、2 班/日、月工作 22: A machining workshop has 5 CNC machines with a capacity of 200 pieces per machine per day, 2 shifts per day, 22 working days per month and monthly orders of 20,000 pieces. Theoretical monthly capacity = 5 × 200 × 22 × 2 = 44,000 pieces; capacity utilization = 20,000 ÷ 44,000 ≈ 45.5% (surplus); the minimum machines needed for this order = ⌈20,000 ÷ (200 × 22 × 2)⌉ = 3. Conclusion: the current 5 machines can take the order comfortably, or the 2 spare machines can be switched to other orders.
map.产能利用率显示超过 100% 说明什么？: What does it mean when capacity utilization shows more than 100%?
map.表示当前设备配置无法在交期内完成订单，缺口 = 订单量 − 理论月产能。需新增设: It means the current equipment configuration cannot complete the order within the deadline; the gap = order quantity − theoretical monthly capacity. Add machines (⌈gap ÷ monthly capacity per machine⌉ machines) or outsource, and check the bottleneck process first.
map.利用率是不是越高越好？: Is a higher utilization always better?
map.不是。利用率长期接近 100% 意味着没有缓冲，任何停机或急单都会违约。本页判据: No. Utilization close to 100% over the long term means there is no buffer, and any downtime or rush order will breach the commitment. This page treats 60%–90% as healthy (below 60% is surplus, above 90% is tight), leaving room for maintenance, changeovers and unexpected orders.
map.请输入有效参数：设备数与每日班次须为正整数，单台班产能>0，需求>0，每月工作日: Enter valid parameters: machines and shifts per day must be positive integers, capacity per machine-shift > 0, demand > 0, and monthly working days an integer from 1 to 31.
map.产能富余,可减少 台设备或增加订单: Excess capacity; reduce machines or take more orders
